approved_architecture_decisions: Use immutable experiment protocols and per-run manifests with stable-request idempotency.
Use one protocol-global cross-run provider lease and one model/reasoning profile for initial comparisons.
Give single_codex only the original task contract and direct access to an independently sanitized repository.
Use independent Git object stores plus bwrap canary enforcement for clean reset and blind-gold isolation.
Enforce token and wall-time budgets only at provider and integration safe boundaries with visible one-call overshoot.
Keep recovery snapshots separate from fsynced, atomically published, immutable terminal result bundles.
Store operator actions in an append-only closed-vocabulary ledger and require epoch-bound live authorization.
Integrate one tracked repo-map handoff for L2 workers rather than relying on excluded .agentteam paths.
Complete the implementation taskpack under the preflight release, then install the reviewed candidate release before freezing a controller-only promotion taskpack.
Require dedicated relation validators to recompute readiness, calibration, authorization, and final-report Git relations.
resolved_contradictions: Separated recoverable interruption snapshots from terminal interrupted result bundles.
Replaced run-local provider concurrency with a protocol-global cross-run lease.
Removed AgentTeam repo-map context from the single_codex comparison mode.
Replaced an in-place runtime hot-load assumption with a reviewed candidate-release handoff.
Moved the repo-map handoff from excluded .agentteam state into a tracked implementation artifact.
Bound the Phase 1 promotion to the recorded remote default head instead of a mutable local remote-tracking ref.
Split implementation and promotion into separately frozen taskpacks so new gate code executes only under the candidate release.
notes: Two independent final reviews found no blocker or major issue. The full native runtime suite passed 721 tests. The preflight release includes the approved materializer and tracked repo-map handoff compatibility needed to validate this taskpack at run startup.
